1.flavorText: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.

2.flavorText: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s coming bloom.

3.flavorText: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

4.flavorText: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

5.flavorText: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

6.flavorText: It is said that Charizard’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

7.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

8.flavorText: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

9.flavorText: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

10.flavorText: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.

11.flavorText: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

12.flavorText: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.

13.flavorText: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.

14.flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

15.flavorText: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.

16.flavorText: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

17.flavorText: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.

18.flavorText: By flapping its wings with all its might, Pidgeot can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.

19.flavorText: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.

20.flavorText: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

21.flavorText: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.

22.flavorText: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.

23.flavorText: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.

24.flavorText: The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.

25.flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

26.flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

27.flavorText: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

28.flavorText: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.

29.flavorText: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.

30.flavorText: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than Nidorino’s.

31.flavorText: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.

32.flavorText: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

33.flavorText: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

34.flavorText: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

35.flavorText: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

36.flavorText: It is very wary and rarely shows itself to people. Its ears can hear a pin drop over half a mile away.

37.flavorText: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

38.flavorText: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

39.flavorText: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

40.flavorText: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.

41.flavorText: It checks its surroundings and location using reflections of the ultrasonic waves from its mouth.

42.flavorText: Its sharp fangs puncture the toughest of hides and have small holes for greedily sucking blood.

43.flavorText: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.

44.flavorText: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.

45.flavorText: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.

46.flavorText: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.

47.flavorText: A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls Parasect. It scatters poisonous spores.

48.flavorText: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

49.flavorText: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.

50.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.

51.flavorText: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

52.flavorText: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

53.flavorText: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.

54.flavorText: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.

55.flavorText: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.

56.flavorText: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

57.flavorText: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

58.flavorText: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

59.flavorText: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

60.flavorText: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.

61.flavorText: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.

62.flavorText: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.

63.flavorText: Using its psychic power is such a strain on its brain that it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day.

64.flavorText: It stares at its silver spoon to focus its mind. It emits more alpha waves while doing so.

65.flavorText: The spoons clutched in its hands are said to have been created by its psychic powers.

66.flavorText: Though small in stature, it is powerful enough to easily heft and throw a number of Geodude at once.

67.flavorText: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.

68.flavorText: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.

69.flavorText: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.

70.flavorText: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.

71.flavorText: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.

72.flavorText: Because its body is almost entirely composed of water, it shrivels up if it is washed ashore.

73.flavorText: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.

74.flavorText: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.

75.flavorText: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokémon can stop it without difficulty.

76.flavorText: Even dynamite can’t harm its hard, boulderlike body. It sheds its hide just once a year.

77.flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

78.flavorText: When at an all-out gallop, its blazing mane sparkles, enhancing its beautiful appearance.

79.flavorText: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.

80.flavorText: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.

81.flavorText: The faster the units at its sides rotate, the greater the magnetic force they generate.

82.flavorText: Many mysteriously appear when more sunspots dot the sun. They stop TV sets from displaying properly.

83.flavorText: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

84.flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

85.flavorText: When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.

86.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

87.flavorText: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.

88.flavorText: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.

89.flavorText: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

90.flavorText: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.

91.flavorText: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.

92.flavorText: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

93.flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

94.flavorText: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.

95.flavorText: It burrows through the ground at a speed of 50 mph while feeding on large boulders.

96.flavorText: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.

97.flavorText: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.

98.flavorText: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.

99.flavorText: The larger pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.

100.flavorText: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

101.flavorText: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

102.flavorText: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

103.flavorText: It is called “The Walking Jungle.” If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.

104.flavorText: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.

105.flavorText: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.

106.flavorText: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.

107.flavorText: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

108.flavorText: When it extends its over-six-foot- long tongue, its tail quivers. There is a possibility they are connected.

109.flavorText: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.

110.flavorText: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.

111.flavorText: Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.

112.flavorText: Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.

113.flavorText: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

114.flavorText: The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.

115.flavorText: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.

116.flavorText: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

117.flavorText: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.

118.flavorText: Though it appears very elegant when swimming with fins unfurled, it can jab powerfully with its horn.

119.flavorText: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

120.flavorText: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.

121.flavorText: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

122.flavorText: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.

123.flavorText: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

124.flavorText: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

125.flavorText: It windmills its arms to slightly boost its punches. Foes have been known to escape in the meantime.

126.flavorText: When it breathes deeply, heat waves form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.

127.flavorText: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.

128.flavorText: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

129.flavorText: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

130.flavorText: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

131.flavorText: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

132.flavorText: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.

133.flavorText: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.

134.flavorText: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can melt away into water.

135.flavorText: If agitated, it uses electricity to straighten out its fur and launch it in small bunches.

136.flavorText: Inhaled air is heated in the flame sac in its body to an intense fire over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

137.flavorText: A man-made Pokémon created using advanced scientific means. It can move freely in cyberspace.

138.flavorText: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.

139.flavorText: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.

140.flavorText: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.

141.flavorText: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.

142.flavorText: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

143.flavorText: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.

144.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

145.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

146.flavorText: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

147.flavorText: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

148.flavorText: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

149.flavorText: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

150.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew’s genes. It’s said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

151.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

152.flavorText: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

153.flavorText: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

154.flavorText: Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead plants and flowers.

155.flavorText: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

156.flavorText: It intimidates foes with the heat of its flames. The fire burns more strongly when it readies to fight.

157.flavorText: It attacks using blasts of fire. It creates heat shimmers with intense fire to hide itself.

158.flavorText: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer needs to be careful.

159.flavorText: Once it bites down, it won’t let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

160.flavorText: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

161.flavorText: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.

162.flavorText: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

163.flavorText: It marks time precisely. Some countries consider it to be a wise friend, versed in the world’s ways.

164.flavorText: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

165.flavorText: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.

166.flavorText: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.

167.flavorText: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.

168.flavorText: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.

169.flavorText: The transformation of its legs into wings made it better at flying, but more clumsy at walking.

170.flavorText: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

171.flavorText: Lanturn’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”

172.flavorText: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.

173.flavorText: It is often seen when shooting stars fill the night skies. It’s said to arrive riding on a shooting star.

174.flavorText: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.

175.flavorText: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.

176.flavorText: To share its happiness, it flies around the world seeking kind- hearted people.

177.flavorText: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.

178.flavorText: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.

179.flavorText: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

180.flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

181.flavorText: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail’s light.

182.flavorText: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

183.flavorText: The oil-filled end of its tail floats on water. It keeps Marill from drowning even in a strong current.

184.flavorText: It can spend all day in water, since it can inhale and store a large volume of air.

185.flavorText: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.

186.flavorText: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make Poliwag obey.

187.flavorText: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

188.flavorText: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.

189.flavorText: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

190.flavorText: It lives high among the treetops. It can use its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.

191.flavorText: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.

192.flavorText: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

193.flavorText: It can hover in one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.

194.flavorText: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

195.flavorText: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

196.flavorText: Its fur is so sensitive, it can sense minute shifts in the air and predict the weather.

197.flavorText: When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

198.flavorText: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.

199.flavorText: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.

200.flavorText: A Pokémon that startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

201.flavorText: When alone, nothing happens. However, if there are two or more, an odd power is said to emerge.

202.flavorText: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

203.flavorText: The head on its tail contains a small brain. It can instinctively fight even while facing backward.

204.flavorText: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

205.flavorText: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.

206.flavorText: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

207.flavorText: It glides as if sliding. It startles foes by clamping on to their faces, then jabs with its poison stinger.

208.flavorText: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

209.flavorText: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.

210.flavorText: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.

211.flavorText: It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.

212.flavorText: It raises its pincers with eyelike markings for intimidation. It also swings them down dangerously.

213.flavorText: It stores berries in its shell. The berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.

214.flavorText: It loves sweet honey. To keep all the honey to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

215.flavorText: A smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

216.flavorText: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.

217.flavorText: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

218.flavorText: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

219.flavorText: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.

220.flavorText: It has a very sensitive nose. It can locate mushrooms, berries, and even hot springs buried under ice.

221.flavorText: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is strong against the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.

222.flavorText: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.

223.flavorText: It forcefully squirts water. The water jet never misses prey even if the Remoraid is deep in the sea.

224.flavorText: It loves to lurk inside holes in rocks. It sometimes sprays ink on prey by sticking out only its mouth.

225.flavorText: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.

226.flavorText: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.

227.flavorText: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.

228.flavorText: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

229.flavorText: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

230.flavorText: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.

231.flavorText: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

232.flavorText: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.

233.flavorText: It was upgraded to enable the exploration of other planets. However, it failed to measure up.

234.flavorText: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.

235.flavorText: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.

236.flavorText: It is famous for its eagerness to fight and always nurses injuries from challenging larger foes.

237.flavorText: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by ten.

238.flavorText: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.

239.flavorText: A weak electric current flows between its horns. Sticking a hand there shocks the unwary.

240.flavorText: Its magma-like blood circulates throughout its body. Its body’s heat can top 1,100 degrees F.

241.flavorText: It is said that kids who drink Miltank’s milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

242.flavorText: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

243.flavorText: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.

244.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

245.flavorText: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

246.flavorText: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.

247.flavorText: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

248.flavorText: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

249.flavorText: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

250.flavorText: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.

251.flavorText: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

252.flavorText: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

253.flavorText: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

254.flavorText: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.

255.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

256.flavorText: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

257.flavorText: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.

258.flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

259.flavorText: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.

260.flavorText: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

261.flavorText: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

262.flavorText: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.

263.flavorText: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.

264.flavorText: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.

265.flavorText: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.

266.flavorText: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.

267.flavorText: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.

268.flavorText: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

269.flavorText: Toxic powder is scattered with each flap. At night, it is known to strip leaves off trees lining boulevards.

270.flavorText: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can’t swim.

271.flavorText: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

272.flavorText: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.

273.flavorText: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

274.flavorText: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

275.flavorText: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

276.flavorText: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

277.flavorText: It circles the sky in search of prey. When it spots one, it dives steeply to catch the prey.

278.flavorText: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

279.flavorText: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

280.flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

281.flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

282.flavorText: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

283.flavorText: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

284.flavorText: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

285.flavorText: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

286.flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

287.flavorText: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

288.flavorText: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.

289.flavorText: The world’s laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

290.flavorText: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

291.flavorText: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

292.flavorText: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.

293.flavorText: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

294.flavorText: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

295.flavorText: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

296.flavorText: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

297.flavorText: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.

298.flavorText: Its tail bounces like a rubber ball. It flings that tail around to fight opponents bigger than itself.

299.flavorText: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.

300.flavorText: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

301.flavorText: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

302.flavorText: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

303.flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

304.flavorText: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

305.flavorText: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.

306.flavorText: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

307.flavorText: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.

308.flavorText: It gains the ability to see the aura of its opponents by honing its mind through starvation.

309.flavorText: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

310.flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

311.flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

312.flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

313.flavorText: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves Illumise’s sweet aroma.

314.flavorText: With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw signs with light in the night sky.

315.flavorText: The more healthy the Roselia, the more pleasant its flowers’ aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.

316.flavorText: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.

317.flavorText: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.

318.flavorText: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.

319.flavorText: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”

320.flavorText: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.

321.flavorText: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

322.flavorText: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

323.flavorText: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.

324.flavorText: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

325.flavorText: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

326.flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psycho-power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

327.flavorText: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

328.flavorText: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

329.flavorText: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.

330.flavorText: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as “The Desert Spirit.”

331.flavorText: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.

332.flavorText: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.

333.flavorText: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

334.flavorText: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

335.flavorText: It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.

336.flavorText: For many generations, it has feuded with Zangoose. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.

337.flavorText: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

338.flavorText: A new Pokémon species, rumored to be from the sun. It gives off light while spinning.

339.flavorText: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.

340.flavorText: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.

341.flavorText: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.

342.flavorText: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.

343.flavorText: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

344.flavorText: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

345.flavorText: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.

346.flavorText: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.

347.flavorText: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.

348.flavorText: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.

349.flavorText: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

350.flavorText: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

351.flavorText: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

352.flavorText: It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.

353.flavorText: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

354.flavorText: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.

355.flavorText: It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.

356.flavorText: It seeks drifting will-o’-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.

357.flavorText: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.

358.flavorText: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.

359.flavorText: Rumored to sense disasters with its horn, it became a target. It fled deep into the mountains.

360.flavorText: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.

361.flavorText: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.

362.flavorText: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.

363.flavorText: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

364.flavorText: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

365.flavorText: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

366.flavorText: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.

367.flavorText: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.

368.flavorText: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.

369.flavorText: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

370.flavorText: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.

371.flavorText: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

372.flavorText: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

373.flavorText: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.

374.flavorText: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

375.flavorText: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.

376.flavorText: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

377.flavorText: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

378.flavorText: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.

379.flavorText: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

380.flavorText: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

381.flavorText: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

382.flavorText: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

383.flavorText: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.

384.flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

385.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

386.flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

387.flavorText: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell should feel moist.

388.flavorText: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

389.flavorText: Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra’s back and spend their entire life there.

390.flavorText: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.

391.flavorText: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

392.flavorText: It uses unique fighting moves with fire on its hands and feet. It will take on any opponent.

393.flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

394.flavorText: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

395.flavorText: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

396.flavorText: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

397.flavorText: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

398.flavorText: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

399.flavorText: A comparison revealed that Bidoof’s front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata’s.

400.flavorText: A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.

401.flavorText: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

402.flavorText: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

403.flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

404.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

405.flavorText: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

406.flavorText: Sensitive to changing temperature, the bud is said to bloom when it feels the sun’s warm touch.

407.flavorText: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.

408.flavorText: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.

409.flavorText: If two were to smash their heads together, their foot-thick skulls would keep them from fainting.

410.flavorText: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.

411.flavorText: When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.

412.flavorText: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.

413.flavorText: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.

414.flavorText: While it loves floral honey, it won’t gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from Combee.

415.flavorText: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.

416.flavorText: It releases various pheromones to make the grubs in its body do its bidding while fighting foes.

417.flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

418.flavorText: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

419.flavorText: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.

420.flavorText: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.

421.flavorText: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun’s rays with its whole body.

422.flavorText: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.

423.flavorText: Long ago, its entire back was shielded with a sturdy shell. There are traces of it left in its cells.

424.flavorText: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, Ambipom rarely uses its hands.

425.flavorText: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.”

426.flavorText: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

427.flavorText: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.

428.flavorText: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

429.flavorText: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

430.flavorText: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”

431.flavorText: It hides its spiteful tendency of hooking its claws into the nose of its Trainer if it isn’t fed.

432.flavorText: It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger. If it locks eyes, it will glare ceaselessly.

433.flavorText: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.

434.flavorText: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

435.flavorText: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.

436.flavorText: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

437.flavorText: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

438.flavorText: It prefers an arid atmosphere. It leaks water that looks like tears when adjusting its moisture level.

439.flavorText: It mimics the expressions and motions of those it sees to understand the feelings of others.

440.flavorText: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others’ feet and cause them to stumble.

441.flavorText: Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.

442.flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

443.flavorText: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

444.flavorText: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

445.flavorText: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

446.flavorText: In its desperation to gulp down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.

447.flavorText: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

448.flavorText: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

449.flavorText: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.

450.flavorText: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.

451.flavorText: As soon as the tail claws close, its needle tips secrete poison. It can survive a year without food.

452.flavorText: Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength, taking down foes without using toxins.

453.flavorText: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

454.flavorText: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

455.flavorText: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling drool and gulps them down.

456.flavorText: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

457.flavorText: It crawls along the seafloor using its long front fins like legs. It competes for food with Lanturn.

458.flavorText: People organize tours to see this Pokémon frolic and skim the tops of waves with Remoraid.

459.flavorText: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.

460.flavorText: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.

461.flavorText: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

462.flavorText: A group tried to use scientific means to make Magnezone evolve, but their efforts ended in failure.

463.flavorText: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.

464.flavorText: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening then expanding muscles instantly.

465.flavorText: Its arms are made of plants that bind themselves to things. They grow back right away if cut.

466.flavorText: Heedless of enemy attacks, it closes in, shoves its tails onto the foe, then looses high voltage.

467.flavorText: When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.

468.flavorText: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another’s rights and avoid needless strife.

469.flavorText: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.

470.flavorText: It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis.

471.flavorText: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.

472.flavorText: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.

473.flavorText: A frozen one was dug up from soil dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement.

474.flavorText: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.

475.flavorText: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

476.flavorText: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

477.flavorText: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

478.flavorText: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

479.flavorText: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

480.flavorText: When Uxie flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.

481.flavorText: When Mesprit flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.

482.flavorText: When Azelf flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.

483.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when Dialga’s heart beats.

484.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with Palkia’s every breath.

485.flavorText: Its body is made of rugged steel. However, it is partially melted in spots because of its own heat.

486.flavorText: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

487.flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

488.flavorText: On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.

489.flavorText: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

490.flavorText: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

491.flavorText: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.

492.flavorText: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

493.flavorText: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.

494.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

495.flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

496.flavorText: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

497.flavorText: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

498.flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

499.flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

500.flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

501.flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

502.flavorText: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

503.flavorText: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

504.flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

505.flavorText: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

506.flavorText: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

507.flavorText: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

508.flavorText: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

509.flavorText: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

510.flavorText: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

511.flavorText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

512.flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

513.flavorText: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

514.flavorText: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

515.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

516.flavorText: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

517.flavorText: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

518.flavorText: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

519.flavorText: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

520.flavorText: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.

521.flavorText: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.

522.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

523.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

524.flavorText: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

525.flavorText: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

526.flavorText: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

527.flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

528.flavorText: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

529.flavorText: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

530.flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

531.flavorText: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

532.flavorText: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

533.flavorText: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

534.flavorText: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

535.flavorText: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

536.flavorText: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

537.flavorText: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

538.flavorText: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

539.flavorText: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

540.flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

541.flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

542.flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

543.flavorText: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

544.flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

545.flavorText: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

546.flavorText: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

547.flavorText: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

548.flavorText: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

549.flavorText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

550.flavorText: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

551.flavorText: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

552.flavorText: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

553.flavorText: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

554.flavorText: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

555.flavorText: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

556.flavorText: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

557.flavorText: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

558.flavorText: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

559.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

560.flavorText: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

561.flavorText: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

562.flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

563.flavorText: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

564.flavorText: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

565.flavorText: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

566.flavorText: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

567.flavorText: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

568.flavorText: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

569.flavorText: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

570.flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

571.flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

572.flavorText: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

573.flavorText: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

574.flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

575.flavorText: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

576.flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

577.flavorText: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

578.flavorText: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

579.flavorText: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

580.flavorText: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.

581.flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

582.flavorText: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

583.flavorText: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

584.flavorText: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

585.flavorText: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

586.flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.

587.flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

588.flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

589.flavorText: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

590.flavorText: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

591.flavorText: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

592.flavorText: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

593.flavorText: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.

594.flavorText: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

595.flavorText: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

596.flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

597.flavorText: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

598.flavorText: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

599.flavorText: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

600.flavorText: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.

601.flavorText: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

602.flavorText: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

603.flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

604.flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

605.flavorText: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.

606.flavorText: It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.

607.flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

608.flavorText: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

609.flavorText: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

610.flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

611.flavorText: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.

612.flavorText: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

613.flavorText: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

614.flavorText: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

615.flavorText: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

616.flavorText: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

617.flavorText: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

618.flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

619.flavorText: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

620.flavorText: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

621.flavorText: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

622.flavorText: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

623.flavorText: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

624.flavorText: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

625.flavorText: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

626.flavorText: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

627.flavorText: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

628.flavorText: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

629.flavorText: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

630.flavorText: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

631.flavorText: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.

632.flavorText: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

633.flavorText: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

634.flavorText: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

635.flavorText: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.

636.flavorText: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

637.flavorText: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.

638.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

639.flavorText: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

640.flavorText: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

641.flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

642.flavorText: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.

643.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

644.flavorText: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

645.flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”

646.flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

647.flavorText: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.

648.flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

649.flavorText: Over 300 million years ago, it was feared as the strongest of hunters. It has been modified by Team Plasma.
